title: Juice bar (fresh juices and smoothies, no alcohol), existing leased storefront — Vega Baja, zone X
description: We are opening a juice bar in an existing leased storefront in Vega Baja. We make fresh juices, smoothies and acai bowls at the counter. We will not sell alcohol. No construction; the space is already finished.

mustInclude.rationale: RULE_0002 municipality baseline: every business gets the IRS EIN; employees also trigger RULE_0620.
RULE_0003 municipality baseline: Registro de Comerciante (SURI).
RULE_0651: new LLC -> Certificate of Organization (Departamento de Estado).
RULE_0004 municipality baseline: Patente Municipal (Ley 107-2020 Codigo Municipal).
RULE_0007: physical commercial premises -> Permiso Unico (Ley 161-2009).
RULE_0020: employees -> CFSE workers' compensation policy.
RULE_0079: BT_JUICE_BAR -> Departamento de Salud sanitary license (Ley 81-1912).
RULE_0081 / RULE_0010: juice bar preparing food on site -> certified food protection manager.

mustNotInclude.rationale: Explicit Q_ALCOHOL_SOLD=false: RULE_0083 carries negated_fact_keys=['Q_ALCOHOL_SOLD'] (REG-ALCOHOL-NEGATED-001; requirementsAudit CASE AW), so the BT-keyed alcohol license is suppressed for a juice bar that does not sell alcohol.
Explicit Q_ALCOHOL_SOLD=false: RULE_0633 (BT_JUICE_BAR alcohol-path prerequisite) carries negated_fact_keys=['Q_ALCOHOL_SOLD'].
Explicit Q_ALCOHOL_SOLD=false: RULE_0634 (BT_JUICE_BAR alcohol-path prerequisite) carries negated_fact_keys=['Q_ALCOHOL_SOLD'].
Explicit Q_ALCOHOL_SOLD=false: RULE_0635 (BT_JUICE_BAR alcohol-path prerequisite) carries negated_fact_keys=['Q_ALCOHOL_SOLD'].
FEMA zone X: RULE_0706/0707 need location.flood_zone.sfha / floodway, which zone X never sets.
No construction stated: RULE_0643-0646 need a construction / renovation project type or structural work.
Pin outside the official coastal zone (NOAA CZMA 'outside'): RULE_0708 needs location.czm.
No SREP land and no change of use in a residential/conservation/agricultural district: RULE_0709-0712 cannot fire.

ordering.rationale: KB documents.json: DOC_PATENTE_MUNICIPAL depends on DOC_PERMISO_UNICO.

notes: Added 2026-10-14 by the scenario loop: first juice bar and first Vega Baja scenario. Exercises explicit-No alcohol suppression for a BT that defaults to the alcohol path; the harness now passes the live intake's session provenance so negated_fact_keys behaves as in production.
